violations.text: The hand-washing sink(s) in the kitchen were lacking paper towels. Additional rolls of paper towels made available at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Clam cakes were observed held at 44-45 degrees Fahrenheit in the retail area display. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Based on time item was stocked on display from colder refrigeration, clam cakes were moved to colder refrigeration at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Recently cooked/prepared food item (seafood salad) was placed into display case prior to cooling to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below (observed at 50 degrees Fahrenheit). Prepared food items are to be properly cooled to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below prior to be placed into display refrigeration to ensure proper cooling and cold holding temperatures. (Seafood Salad was moved to the walk-in cooler for rapid cooling at the time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Reduced Oxygen Packaged Crab Meat was observed held thawed in its intact packaging. Frozen, Reduced Oxygen Packaged Seafood items labeled Keep Frozen, are to be removed from the ROP Packaging immediately upon thawing. Due to ROP Crab Meat observed at 35 degrees Fahrenheit, ROP Crab Meat was removed from packaging for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Food items prepared and packaged in the food establishment are lacking complete labels ("spices" listed - must have the actual spice name, and cracker as ingredient needs all sub ingredients). Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of all ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). A quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength of 150 - 400 ppm as indicated on the manufacturers' label. Water was added to the Sanitizer solution for a proper mixture of Quaternary Ammonium and retested at the time of inspection Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

At the time of inspection, salmon burgers were observed held in refrigeration in Reduced Oxygen Packaging. Per the Owner, the Salmon Burgers are packaged on site. Establishment currently does not have approval from the RIDOH CFP to perform the special process of vacuum sealing food items. Establishment is to stop vacuum sealing of any food products until approved by RIDOH CFP Supervisor. (Salmon Burgers were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

Recently cooked/prepared food items (scampi salads, snail salad, Frutti Di Mar Salad) were placed into display cooler refrigeration prior to cooling to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Prepared food items are to be properly cooled to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below prior to be placed into display refrigeration to ensure proper cooling and cold holding temperatures. (Food items were moved to the walk-in cooler for rapid cooling at the time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

Reduced Oxygen Packaged Crab Meat was observed held thawed in its intact packaging. Frozen, Reduced Oxygen Packaged Seafood items labeled Keep Frozen, are to be removed from the ROP Packaging immediately upon thawing. Due to ROP Crab Meat observed above 38 degrees Fahrenheit, ROP Crab Meat was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2025

The wall mounted sanitizer dispenser at the 3-bay sink was observed to be dispensing Quaternary Ammonium above 400ppm. Sanitizer dispenser is to be adjusted to proper mixture. (PIC is to ensure staff add water to dilute the chemical sanitizer and use test strips to ensure proper sanitizing.) New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/31/2024

No person in charge certified in Food Safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. There is to be a person certified in food safety on site at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Per the PIC, currently preparing to take a Food Safety Course/Test. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2024

At the time of inspection, per interview with the PIC, shellfish tags are marked with the last date of use when removed from the walk-in, not when last piece sold to customers. Shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used/sold from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2024

Reduced Oxygen Packaged Smoked Salmon observed in a Reduced Oxygen Packaging labeled KEEP REFRIGERATED AT 38 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT OR BELOW, was observed held at 43 degrees Fahrenheit. Due to fish observed held under refrigeration at a temperature higher than item care instructions stated by the manufacturer, ROP Smoked Salmon was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for the following time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods... - Recently cooked Chowders were observed cooling in the walk-in cooler in covered pans greater than 4 inches deep at 77 to 115 degrees Fahrenheit. Chowders were moved to the walk-in freezer for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. - Shrimp cooked on site just prior to inspection were observed in the seafood display at 43 to 50 degrees. Items cooked on site are to be fully cooled in colder refrigeration prior to being placed in display case. Ice was added to the shrimp for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2024

At the time of inspection, a wire strainer basket was observed to be frayed/broken in the kitchen area was not in good repair. PIC voluntarily disposed of the strainer at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2024

Areas of the basement were observed to have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris under/behind pallets and equipment. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 10/31/2024
